# EvoUI 0.3.0

Library: `@evotechly/ui` — React components for Evotechly DS 2.0.
Tokens: `@evotechly/brand` via `<html data-product="crm" data-theme="light">`.
No EvoCRM runtime. Light + dark. Geist Sans / Geist Mono.

```ts
import "@evotechly/ui/styles.css";
import { EvoButton, EvoInput, EvoDataTable } from "@evotechly/ui";
```

Props: `size` (sm|md|lg), `variant` (primary|secondary|outline|ghost|danger|link), `tone` (neutral|brand|success|warning|danger|info), `asChild`.
Primary button fill: `--brand-actionA11y`. Brand text: `--brand-text`. Focus ring required.
Catalog: `packages/ui/src/catalog.json`. Docs: `packages/ui/docs/components/<slug>.md`.
Attribution: `packages/ui/NOTICE` (Apache-2.0 Spectrum + MIT SmoothUI / Intent UI / Kibo / assistant-ui).
In-house: Radix, Tiptap, react-resizable-panels, input-otp, libphonenumber-js, @tanstack/react-virtual, dnd-kit.
Do not hard-code hex. Do not add AGPL or three.js. Do not publish from this change.
